transcript: Unlike, say, Syria or Myanmar where the government was hostile to any kind of accountability efforts because they themselves were complicit in crimes, here we have a democratically elected government that has justice and law enforcement authorities and a mandate to deal with crimes that are occurring on its sovereign territory. There may well be a mix of international and domestic approaches to this, but our focus is really centered on supporting the Ukrainian National Authority.
